description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Log Viewer: The all new log viewer includes a bunch of improvements such as: Log Level filtering via structured parsing, improved performance, histogram for log volumes with quick navigation, different formats for download/copy, regex/match case filtering, inverse filtering and pause/resume
- Log Viewer: View logs from multiple unrelated pods, just select some and right click (or press L) to view combined logs
💎 Improvements
- Navigation: Auto scroll the sidebar to the selected Kind when using Cmd+K
🐞 Fixes
- CRDs: Fixed a bug where the CRD filter would become invisible if no CRDs were found
- Windows: Fix Shift+Ctrl+C windows bug on In-App Terminal Discord
- Windows: Fix Ctrl+J showing the system's download dialog Discord
